project: Position-Dependent Curvature for Hyperbolic Embeddings of Medical Ontologies

constant_curvature_alpha0_trained.note: the method's own alpha=0 after joint training; honest curvature baseline

constant_curvature_alpha0_eval_only.note: loaded Phase2 ref, evaluated without further training

baselines_other_dims.note: d=5 hyperbolic >> euclidean (geometry matters); d=50 euclidean wins (room ample)

method.name: Tree-Anchored Variable Curvature (Method 1)
method.field: kappa(x) = kappa_scale * tanh(W . features), kernel-smoothed over a frozen reference cloud
method.distance: line-integral of conformal factor over straight chord, num_steps=16

broken_warmup_root_cause.problem: in-notebook warmup lacked hierarchy loss -> depth-inverted, origin-piled cloud (58% nodes within 0.05 of origin)
broken_warmup_root_cause.symptom: capped MAP ~0.67; bandwidth h collapsed to 0.0034
broken_warmup_root_cause.fix: load Phase2 hierarchy-trained ref; alpha=0 reproduces 0.745; h recovers to 0.55

alpha_sweep.shape: symmetric V in MAP, Lambda in mean_rank, around alpha=0
alpha_sweep.sign_symmetry: sign of alpha is meaningless - learnable field absorbs it; only |alpha| matters
alpha_sweep.ceiling: MAP peaks at |alpha|~0.8 then declines; mean_rank keeps falling past peak (tail vs MAP tradeoff)

binary_switch.finding: field collapses to a binary leaf/internal partition, NOT a graded branching law
binary_switch.kappa_vs_branching: step function: leaf -> -1, all internal (b=1..15) -> +1 flat
ablations_confirming_intrinsic: desaturation (kappa_scale 1.0/0.5/0.2): same binary shape rescaled; identical MAP 0.7752 -> saturation NOT the cause
MLP + 6 rich features (depth, sibling, dist-to-root, imbalance): internal nodes STILL flat -> capacity/features NOT the cause
binary_switch.conclusion: leaf/internal distinction is the COMPLETE learnable curvature signal at d=10; branching magnitude carries no usable signal

desaturation_d10_seed0_alpha_coscaled.note: identical MAP - alpha*kappa held constant; binary shape invariant to scale

L0_base_embedding_fix.note: biggest single fix; broken warmup -> Phase2 hierarchy ref

L1_bpr_loss.note: loss not the bottleneck; BPR better meanR(108) worse MAP

L_internal_only_field.note: best tail in project at the time; graded INVERTED internal law; MAP below full field

L2_base_retrain.note: homemade + verbatim-Phase2 trainer both invert depth ordering in this notebook; cause unidentified (env/version); loaded ref retained. Inputs verified clean (tree N-1 edges, parent->child orientation)

L3_desaturation.note: binary switch is NOT saturation; same MAP 0.7752 at all scales

L3_mlp_rich_features.note: 6 features + MLP still binary on branching axis; BUT best mean_rank in project (81); field sign-flipped (internal=-1)

standing_conclusions.map_ceiling_d10: ~0.775, triply confirmed; equals Euclidean d10 (0.777) = dimension's natural capacity
standing_conclusions.curvature_effect: small on MAP (+0.015), LARGE on mean_rank (460 -> 81-136, ~70-80% tail reduction)
standing_conclusions.mechanism: learned leaf/internal curvature partition; cleans boundary-shell tail; branching magnitude irrelevant
standing_conclusions.0.90_target: dimensional, not curvature - requires d>10 (Euclidean d50=0.975). No d=10 lever spans the +0.12 gap
standing_conclusions.publishable_claim: position-dependent curvature improves hierarchical embedding via a learned leaf/internal partition; effect concentrated in the tail and (predicted) in the low-dim regime where geometry is scarce

open_untested.d5_sweep: HIGH VALUE - thesis predicts effect GROWS where space scarce; never tested
open_untested.d50_sweep: the 0.90 path; open Q whether curvature still helps at high d
open_untested.two_stage_leaf_learning: internal learns then leaves learn own kappa (not just inherit)
open_untested.multiseed_optimum: alpha=-0.8 across seeds 1,2 for error bars before writeup
open_untested.math_derivations: |K| ~ (log b)^2 from volume growth; Cartan-Hadamard preservation; line-integral error bound (all unstarted)
